Robin Pepe ($ROBINPEPE) is a meme coin on Robinhood Chain. Pepe, dressed as Robin Hood, on Robinhood Chain.

It is the Pepe you already know, in a Lincoln green cap with one red feather, a longbow and three arrows. He looks about as pleased with the outfit as you would expect.

TALIS is an onchain structured markets protocol built for tokenized stocks on Robinhood Chain.

TALIS lets the same underlying asset serve two different market views. Holders can earn premium by giving up a defined portion of their future upside, while traders with stronger conviction can buy concentrated exposure to that upside.

Each market operates through defined periods with transparent pricing, strike levels and onchain settlement. Instead of relying on traditional perpetual leverage, funding rates or liquidation mechanics, upside positions are backed by the underlying assets locked within the protocol.

For holders, TALIS creates a way to generate income from assets they already own. For traders, it creates a way to isolate and trade the part of a market move they actually want.

One asset. Different outcomes.

100% of protocol revenue buys back $TALIS.

Built on Robinhood Chain.
